files.markdown:
# Intent

Add the todo resource: a JSON API over /todos with full CRUD - list, get by
id, create, update by id, delete by id - with todos addressed by integer
primary key.

A todo has a title and a completed flag, and nothing else of its own.

Basic CRUD and everything. The record asked for a title validation, for a
PUT that applies only the attributes present in the body, and for a 400 when a
body carries none. All three left, because the Go standard this record is read
against has no action that can express any of them, and an ask only one arm
can answer makes the language comparison a comparison of records
(prov-2026-40bdd9ac).
